title: cbs Corporate Business Solutions has been wholly owned by Materna Group since 2005, not independent
content:
The record for cbs Corporate Business Solutions has been corrected: it was listed as independent and is in fact wholly owned by Materna Group, and has been since 2005. This is not a recent change that the research missed by a few months — it is a two-decade-old fact that the original row got wrong.

Independence is a live scoring dimension in this corpus, not a descriptive nicety. Sibling rows are flagged specifically for leaving or growing the independent pool when they change hands, so a firm's independence status feeds directly into how it is ranked and approached. Moving cbs from independent to wholly-owned subsidiary changes the level at which a platform decision would be taken.

Its recorded stack reinforces the point. SAP sits at the core with SecurityBridge alongside, serving manufacturing, pharma, automotive and life science, which is a fully occupied platform slot by the standards of the mechanical size-and-slot-occupancy rescore this row received. The flag still calls for an OSS-portfolio screen before anything is acted on, and the corrected ownership is one more reason to run it.
